sloka: यस्तयोः पूर्वजो जातः स कुशैर्मन्त्रसत्कृतैः ।निर्मार्जनीयस्तु तदा कुश इत्यस्य नाम तत् ।। ७.६६.७ ॥
transliteration: yastayoḥ pūrvajo jātaḥ sa kuśairmantrasatkṛtaiḥ ।nirmārjanīyastu tadā kuśa ityasya nāma tat ।। 7.66.7 ॥

translations.english: The one who was born first of the two, he was to be purified with Kuśa grass consecrated by mantras, and thus his name became Kuśa.
